method: Unmodified simulateChapter(seed) via real GameService, SaveRepository and MemoryStorage; new save per candidate/seed; real recruiting, advancement, skill generation and collection; every wave checkpoint/restart equality and duplicate-completion checks; no Cocos/player save writes. Observations wrap exported stepBattle, calling original exactly once per invocation. Restored and uninterrupted twin states overwrite the same observational wave key and are asserted equal by the simulator.
limitations: Fixed non-optimized formation and recruitment order: spike1, stone2, crystal3, leaf4, bubble5. Stone2 may never block on some levels. This is not the root actual crystal-first / stone1-crystal2 playthrough or an optimal formation.
Fresh-save progression only; no mature fixture, no ad bonuses, no injected stats or skills, no fusion decisions, no human choices, no retries.
Eight deterministic seeds are paired regression scenarios, not population win-rate estimates. Later levels also inherit candidate-dependent service outcomes from preceding levels.

Duration includes scripted preparation only; excludes art loading, pauses, menus, decisions and collection interaction. Ally HP metrics are wave-end snapshots including dead units as zero, not sampled minimum throughout combat.
New waves use balanceVersion 2. This report does not test legacy combat snapshot adoption or deployment migration.
